  config: ""          # optional workflow YAML; used to locate rds_datalist
  rds_datalist: ""    # path to datalist.rds (overrides config$rds_datalist)
  stage: "cleaned"    # raw | cleaned | norm
  norm_method: ""     # only for stage = norm; empty = first available method
  samples: ""         # sample names (vector or comma-separated); empty = all samples
  features: ""        # feature names (vector or comma-separated); empty = all IS features
  sample_types: ""    # optional Sample.type filter (vector or comma-separated); empty = all
  shewhart_ref: "PO"  # sample types used for Shewhart control limits; falls back to all selected samples
---

```{r setup environment, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Parse a parameter given either as a vector or as a comma-separated string
parse_param_list <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(character(0))
  x <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(unlist(x)), ",", fixed = TRUE)))
  unique(x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)])
}

manual_colors <- c("#3C5488CC", "#F39B7FCC", "#91D1C2CC", "#925E9FCC", "#0099B4CC", "#7E6148CC", "#8491B4CC", "#B09C85CC", "#E64B35CC", "#4DBBD5CC",
    "#00A087CC", "#00468BCC", "#ED0000CC", "#42B540CC", "#DC0000CC", "#3B4992CC", "#EE0000CC", "#008B45CC", "#631879CC", "#008280CC",
    "#BB0021CC", "#5F559BCC", "#A20056CC", "#808180CC", "#1B1919CC", "#FDAF91CC", "#AD002ACC")

plotly_box <- function(p) {
  p %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(showline = TRUE, linewidth = 1, linecolor = '#999999', mirror = "all"),
      yaxis = list(showline = TRUE, linewidth = 1, linecolor = '#999999', mirror = "all")
    )
}

# Extract a long table (Feature x Sample) for one ionization mode
extract_mode_long <- function(datalist, mode, stage, norm_method,
                              samples, features, sample_types) {

  x <- get_mode(datalist, mode, required = FALSE)
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  peaks <- switch(stage, raw = x$peaks, cleaned = x$peaks_cleaned, norm = x$peaks_norm)
  feat  <- switch(stage, raw = x$features, x$features_cleaned)
  meta  <- switch(stage, raw = x$meta, cleaned = x$meta_cleaned, norm = x$meta_norm)

  if (identical(stage, "norm") && is.list(peaks) && !is.data.frame(peaks)) {
    if (length(peaks) == 0) return(NULL)
    method <- if (nzchar(norm_method)) norm_method else names(peaks)[1]
    if (!method %in% names(peaks)) {
      stop("Normalization method '", method, "' not found in ", mode,
           " mode. Available: ", paste(names(peaks), collapse = ", "))
    }
    peaks <- peaks[[method]]
  }
  if (is.null(peaks) || is.null(feat) || is.null(meta)) return(NULL)

  # ---- Orient peaks as features x samples and align feature table by name ----
  # raw/cleaned peaks are features x samples (rownames = Feature_ID);
  # normalized peaks are samples x features (colnames = Identity).
  peaks <- as.matrix(peaks)
  feat <- as.data.frame(feat)
  meta <- as.data.frame(meta)
  if (sum(rownames(peaks) %in% meta$Sample) > sum(colnames(peaks) %in% meta$Sample)) {
    peaks <- t(peaks)
  }
  key <- NULL
  for (col in intersect(c("Feature_ID", "Identity"), names(feat))) {
    if (!is.null(rownames(peaks)) && all(rownames(peaks) %in% feat[[col]])) { key <- col; break }
  }
  if (!is.null(key)) {
    feat <- feat[match(rownames(peaks), feat[[key]]), , drop = FALSE]
  } else if (nrow(peaks) != nrow(feat)) {
    stop("Cannot align peaks with feature table in ", mode, " mode (stage ", stage, ")")
  }

  # ---- Feature selection: match on Identity, Identity_raw or Feature_ID ----
  feat$.row <- seq_len(nrow(feat))
  if (length(features) == 0) {
    keep.f <- !is.na(feat$Feature_type) & feat$Feature_type == "IS"
  } else {
    keep.f <- rep(FALSE, nrow(feat))
    for (col in intersect(c("Identity", "Identity_raw", "Feature_ID"), names(feat))) {
      keep.f <- keep.f | (as.character(feat[[col]]) %in% features)
    }
  }
  feat <- feat[keep.f, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(feat) == 0) return(NULL)

  # ---- Sample selection: match on Sample or File.name ----
  sample.cols <- colnames(peaks)
  meta <- meta[match(sample.cols, meta$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  keep.s <- rep(TRUE, nrow(meta))
  if (length(samples) > 0) {
    keep.s <- meta$Sample %in% samples |
      (if ("File.name" %in% names(meta)) meta$File.name %in% samples else FALSE)
  }
  if (length(sample_types) > 0) {
    keep.s <- keep.s & meta$Sample.type %in% sample_types
  }
  meta <- meta[keep.s, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(meta) == 0) return(NULL)

  mat <- peaks[feat$.row, meta$Sample, drop = FALSE]
  feat.label <- if ("Identity" %in% names(feat)) feat$Identity else rownames(peaks)[feat$.row]

  out <- data.frame(
    Feature   = rep(feat.label, times = ncol(mat)),
    Sample    = rep(meta$Sample, each = nrow(mat)),
    Intensity = as.vector(mat),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    left_join(meta %>% select(any_of(c("Sample", "Sample.type", "Sample.batch", "Run.order"))),
              by = "Sample")

  if (!"Run.order" %in% names(out)) out$Run.order <- match(out$Sample, meta$Sample)
  if (!"Sample.type" %in% names(out)) out$Sample.type <- "Sample"
  out$Mode <- mode
  out
}

show_table <- function(df) {
  if (has_kableExtra) kableExtra::kable_paper(knitr::kable(df)) else knitr::kable(df, format = "html")
}

summarise_long <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Feature, Sample.type) %>%
    summarise(
      n         = n(),
      n.missing = sum(is.na(Intensity) | Intensity == 0),
      median    = median(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean      = mean(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      RSD       = sd(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Per feature: a bar plot and a Shewhart control chart over the selected
# samples. The x axis is the position among the selected samples (in run
# order), so gaps from unselected runs are dropped; the real run order is
# shown on hover. Control limits (mean, +/-2SD, +/-3SD) are computed from the
# `ref_types` sample types (all selected samples if none of them are present).
plot_feature_intensity <- function(df, ref_types = character(0)) {
  out <- htmltools::tagList()
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(Position = dense_rank(Run.order),
           Hover = paste0("Sample: ", Sample,
                          "<br>Sample type: ", Sample.type,
                          "<br>Run order: ", Run.order))
  # Fixed colour per sample type, shared by both plots
  type.levels <- sort(unique(as.character(df$Sample.type)))
  type.colors <- setNames(manual_colors[seq_along(type.levels)], type.levels)

  for (f in unique(df$Feature)) {
    d <- df %>% filter(Feature == f) %>% arrange(Position)
    if (all(is.na(d$Intensity))) next

    p.run <-
      ggplot(d, aes(x = Position, y = Intensity, fill = Sample.type, text = Hover)) +
      geom_col() +
      labs(x = "Selected samples (in run order)", y = "Intensity", title = f,
           fill = "Sample type") +
      theme_bw() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = type.colors)

    ref <- d$Intensity[d$Sample.type %in% ref_types]
    ref.label <- paste(intersect(ref_types, d$Sample.type), collapse = ", ")
    if (sum(!is.na(ref)) < 2) {
      ref <- d$Intensity
      ref.label <- "all selected samples"
    }
    m <- mean(ref, na.rm = TRUE)
    s <- sd(ref, na.rm = TRUE)
    limits <- data.frame(
      y     = c(m, m + 2 * s, m - 2 * s, m + 3 * s, m - 3 * s),
      group = c("Mean", "+/-2 SD", "+/-2 SD", "+/-3 SD", "+/-3 SD"),
      color = c("#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#F39B7F", "#E64B35", "#E64B35"),
      dash  = c("solid", "dash", "dash", "dot", "dot")
    )
    x.range <- range(d$Position) + c(-0.5, 0.5)

    # Built natively in plotly: ggplotly() mangles the combined legends
    p.shew <- plot_ly()
    for (k in seq_len(nrow(limits))) {
      p.shew <- p.shew %>%
        add_lines(x = x.range, y = rep(limits$y[k], 2),
                  name = limits$group[k], legendgroup = limits$group[k],
                  showlegend = !duplicated(limits$group)[k],
                  line = list(color = limits$color[k], dash = limits$dash[k], width = 1.2),
                  hovertemplate = paste0(limits$group[k], ": %{y:.4g}<extra></extra>"))
    }
    for (ty in intersect(names(type.colors), unique(d$Sample.type))) {
      p.shew <- p.shew %>%
        add_markers(data = d[d$Sample.type == ty, ], x = ~Position, y = ~Intensity,
                    name = ty, text = ~Hover,
                    hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Intensity: %{y}<extra></extra>",
                    marker = list(size = 7, color = substr(type.colors[[ty]], 1, 7),
                                  line = list(color = "#333333", width = 0.5)))
    }
    p.shew <- p.shew %>%
      layout(
        title = list(text = paste0(f, " - Shewhart chart (limits from ", ref.label, ")"),
                     x = 0, font = list(size = 14)),
        xaxis = list(title = "Selected samples (in run order)", zeroline = FALSE),
        yaxis = list(title = "Intensity", zeroline = FALSE)
      )

    out[[paste0(f, "_run")]]  <- as_widget(plotly_box(ggplotly(p.run, tooltip = c("text", "y"))))
    out[[paste0(f, "_shew")]] <- as_widget(plotly_box(p.shew))
  }
  out
}

```

```{r pipeline input}

config <- if (nzchar(params$config)) wf_read_yaml_config(params$config, label = "params$config") else list()

rds_datalist <- if (nzchar(params$rds_datalist)) params$rds_datalist else config$rds_datalist
if (is.null(rds_datalist) || !nzchar(rds_datalist)) {
  stop("Provide params$rds_datalist or a config with rds_datalist")
}
if (!file.exists(rds_datalist)) stop("datalist file not found: ", rds_datalist)

stage        <- match.arg(tolower(params$stage), c("raw", "cleaned", "norm"))
norm_method  <- as.character(params$norm_method)
sel_samples  <- parse_param_list(params$samples)
sel_features <- parse_param_list(params$features)
sel_types    <- parse_param_list(params$sample_types)
shew_ref     <- parse_param_list(params$shewhart_ref)

datalist <- as_metpipe_datalist(readRDS(rds_datalist), validate = FALSE)

data.pos <- extract_mode_long(datalist, "pos", stage, norm_method, sel_samples, sel_features, sel_types)
data.neg <- extract_mode_long(datalist, "neg", stage, norm_method, sel_samples, sel_features, sel_types)

run.pos <- !is.null(data.pos) && nrow(data.pos) > 0
run.neg <- !is.null(data.neg) && nrow(data.neg) > 0

if (!run.pos && !run.neg) {
  stop("No matching features/samples found in either mode for the given selection.",
       if (stage == "norm" && length(sel_features) == 0)
         " Internal standards are typically removed after normalization; pass `features` explicitly.")
}

```

## Selection
```{r}

cat("Datalist: ", rds_datalist, "\n")
cat("Stage:    ", stage, if (stage == "norm") paste0("(", if (nzchar(norm_method)) norm_method else "first method", ")"), "\n")
cat("Samples:  ", if (length(sel_samples)) paste(sel_samples, collapse = ", ") else "all", "\n")
cat("Features: ", if (length(sel_features)) paste(sel_features, collapse = ", ") else "all internal standards", "\n")
cat("Sample types: ", if (length(sel_types)) paste(sel_types, collapse = ", ") else "all", "\n")
cat("Shewhart limits from: ", if (length(shew_ref)) paste(shew_ref, collapse = ", ") else "all selected samples", "\n")

found <- unique(c(if (run.pos) data.pos$Feature, if (run.neg) data.neg$Feature))
if (length(sel_features) > 0) {
  missing.f <- setdiff(sel_features, found)
  if (length(missing.f) > 0) cat("\nFeatures not matched by Identity: ", paste(missing.f, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
found.s <- unique(c(if (run.pos) data.pos$Sample, if (run.neg) data.neg$Sample))
if (length(sel_samples) > 0) {
  missing.s <- setdiff(sel_samples, found.s)
  if (length(missing.s) > 0) cat("Samples not found: ", paste(missing.s, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

```

## Positive mode

::: panel-tabset

### Summary
```{r summary pos, eval = run.pos}

summarise_long(data.pos) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, function(x) round(x, 2)) %>%
  show_table()

```

### Intensity
```{r intensity pos, eval = run.pos, fig.height = 5}

plot_feature_intensity(data.pos, ref_types = shew_ref)

```
:::

## Negative mode

::: panel-tabset

### Summary
```{r summary neg, eval = run.neg}

summarise_long(data.neg) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, function(x) round(x, 2)) %>%
  show_table()

```

### Intensity
```{r intensity neg, eval = run.neg, fig.height = 5}

plot_feature_intensity(data.neg, ref_types = shew_ref)

```
